stages.advisory: Deep plough once, 2-3 cross harrowing. Apply 10-12 tonnes FYM/ha.
Seed rate 100 kg/ha, row spacing 20cm. Treat with Vitavax @ 2.5 g/kg.
Crown root initiation (CRI) – critical irrigation. 21 days after sowing.
Apply 1/3 N (Urea 65 kg/ha) after first irrigation.
Monitor for aphids. Apply second irrigation at tillering if dry.
Apply remaining 1/3 N at late tillering.
Third irrigation. Scout for yellow rust; spray Propiconazole 25EC @ 0.1% if spotted.
Fourth irrigation critical for grain filling. Avoid water stress.
Fifth irrigation. Watch for Karnal bunt in humid conditions.
Harvest at golden-yellow stage, grain moisture 12-14%. Avoid delay to prevent shattering.
Prepare wet nursery bed 1000 sq ft per acre. Seed rate 20 kg/ha (hybrid 15 kg/ha).
Transplant 21-25 day old seedlings. 2-3 seedlings per hill, 20×15 cm spacing. Puddled field.
Maintain 5cm standing water. Apply 1/3 N at 21 DAT. Monitor for stem borer.
Apply final 1/3 N. Critical water stage – no stress. Scout for BPH.
Maintain shallow water. If BLB detected, drain and spray Streptocycline.
Alternate wetting/drying. Apply potash spray if leaves yellowing.
Drain 10 days before harvest. Harvest at 20-22% grain moisture. Dry to 14%.
